mapper.select: SELECT dh.history_id AS "historyId" , dh.upload_id AS "uploadId" , dh.source_id AS "sourceId" , COALESCE(dh.upload_file_name, d.source_name, dh.source_id) AS "title" , d.source_name AS "sourceName" , d.table_name AS "tableName" , c.category_id AS "categoryId" , c.description AS "categoryDescription" , dh.description AS "description" , dh.file_path AS "filePath" , dh.status AS "status" , CASE dh.status WHEN '01' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN '02' THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN '03' THEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL' WHEN '04' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS "statusLabel" , COALESCE(dh.first_register_user, d.owner_id, 'SYSTEM') AS "submittedBy" , dh.archived_at AS "submittedAt" , get_upload_record_count(d.table_name, dh.upload_id) AS "totalRecords" FROM datasource_history dh LEFT JOIN datasource d ON dh.source_id = d.source_id LEFT JOIN category c ON d.category_id = c.category_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( NULLIF(#{status}, '') IS NULL OR dh.status = #{status} ) AND ( NULLIF(#{sourceId}, '') IS NULL OR dh.source_id = #{sourceId} ) AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR dh.source_id ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR dh.upload_file_name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR d.source_name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR c.description ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' ) ORDER BY dh.archived_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM datasource_history dh LEFT JOIN datasource d ON dh.source_id = d.source_id LEFT JOIN category c ON d.category_id = c.category_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( NULLIF(#{status}, '') IS NULL OR dh.status = #{status} ) AND ( NULLIF(#{sourceId}, '') IS NULL OR dh.source_id = #{sourceId} ) AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR dh.source_id ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR dh.upload_file_name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR d.source_name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR c.description ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' )

SELECT dh.history_id AS "historyId" , dh.upload_id AS "uploadId" , dh.source_id AS "sourceId" , COALESCE(dh.upload_file_name, d.source_name, dh.source_id) AS "title" , d.source_name AS "sourceName" , d.table_name AS "tableName" , c.category_id AS "categoryId" , c.description AS "categoryDescription" , dh.description AS "description" , dh.file_path AS "filePath" , dh.status AS "status" , CASE dh.status WHEN '01' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN '02' THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN '03' THEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL' WHEN '04' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS "statusLabel" , COALESCE(dh.first_register_user, d.owner_id, 'SYSTEM') AS "submittedBy" , dh.archived_at AS "submittedAt" , dh.row_data AS "rawData" FROM datasource_history dh LEFT JOIN datasource d ON dh.source_id = d.source_id LEFT JOIN category c ON d.category_id = c.category_id WHERE dh.upload_id = #{uploadId} LIMIT 1

SELECT audit_id AS "auditId" , upload_id AS "uploadId" , source_id AS "sourceId" , action AS "action" , action_by AS "actionBy" , action_date AS "actionDate" , action_time AS "actionTime" , previous_status AS "previousStatus" , new_status AS "newStatus" , reason AS "reason" , created_at AS "createdAt" FROM upload_approval_audit WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} ORDER BY audit_id DESC
